name: Computers and labs
summary: Use campus computer labs and get device support

details.title: Computer labs
details.html: York operates drop-in computing spaces and course-specific teaching labs, with software for learning and research. Lab access depends on student status and faculty or course eligibility. The Steacie hallway computers are identified as an active-student service

details.title: Remote labs
details.html: Eligible users can access certain lab computers remotely where the faculty offers this service. Remote Desktop access can require an active VPN connection and authorization to the specific lab or computer

details.title: Managed workstations
details.html: Desktop support and workstation services depend on the faculty or department. For a York-owned device, contact your local IT support team for support with equipment, setup, account access or software problems
